strongest_objection: The dependency edge Someone to sue → Seizable title, which form_inference says splits the whole map, partitions it wrongly: it lists Body that can be brought among the court-free holds when custody is the most state-dependent hold on the map (Kneecap's own discriminator says so), lists Name and Rent as leash among the court holds when a brand binds through customers and a license through a licensor, and omits the crossing, the cosigner, and the file altogether; a protocol with no wrapper is bound by its name and its taps, which the edge says it cannot be. The loop edge has a smaller version of the same fault, since know-your-customer anchors a file to papers, not to a body, and the return to the body runs through the fraud statute. Both structural claims survive once relabeled, which is why this is repair and not return: I tried to break the loop (bail, secured card, prosecution of synthetic identity) and the fork (garage versus roof) and could not; the dependency holds as a claim about judgments, not about courts in general.

items.item: Rented door: a party becomes bindable on paper by naming a place at which it agrees to be deemed found, so that a summons left there counts as received whether or not anyone read it, as a Delaware company buys a registered agent's address for a small annual fee and a tenant gives an address the landlord can nail a notice to; contracting with an entity nobody will ever visit exists only because it can be served, and a person of no fixed abode cannot rent, bank, or be sued, which leaves them bindable only by body; escaped by letting the door lapse, the agent resigning or the mail returning; not a body, which must be brought, but a place where ignorance can no longer be claimed, bought in a day for the cost of the rent.
items.why: Weakest fit to the type: nothing of the party's sits in the creditor's hand except its plea of ignorance, which the item should say outright. The escape is inverted as written: a registered agent who resigns is replaced by the Secretary of State for service, and returned mail becomes a notice nailed to the door, so lapse does not escape the hold but speeds the default judgment; the only escape is never renting a door, which the item itself says forfeits every paper market.
items.repair: Rented door: a party becomes bindable on paper by naming a place at which it agrees to be deemed found, so that a summons left there counts as received whether or not anyone read it, as a Delaware company buys a registered agent's address for a small annual fee and a tenant gives an address the landlord can nail a notice to; what is held is the party's plea of ignorance, since silence at the door becomes a default judgment, and contracting with an entity nobody will ever visit exists only because it can be served, while a person of no fixed abode cannot rent, bank, or be sued, which leaves them bindable only by body; not escaped by letting the door lapse, since a resigned agent is replaced by the Secretary of State and returned mail by a notice posted on the door, so that lapse only speeds the default, but only by never renting one, which forfeits every paper market at once; not a body, which must be brought, but a place where ignorance can no longer be claimed, bought in a day for the cost of the rent.

items.item: Someone to sue: a promise can be enforced only against a thing the law recognizes as able to bear an obligation, so a market wanting a side that cannot be bound, a town before incorporation, a club, a protocol without a wrapper, a river, the unborn party to a hundred-year carbon contract, is born only when a proxy is deputized to stand for that side, and the proxy's own holds then govern the market; municipal bonds exist only because a city is a person that can be sued, and a club whose treasurer is personally liable cannot borrow at all; the trading twin of witness-architectures' Deputized injury, which names who may bring a harm, and the two come apart, since a river with a guardian can sue but nobody lends to a river, because no hold reaches the guardian's purse; escaped by dissolving the person or by immunity; bought in a day for a company, never for a river.
items.why: 'A club whose treasurer is personally liable cannot borrow at all' is false as stated; such clubs borrow constantly, on the treasurer's own name, which is this map's Cosigner and stops the day the treasurer will not sign. The corrected case is stronger, since it shows the non-person's market running on a member's holds, which is the item's own thesis.
items.repair: Someone to sue: a promise can be enforced only against a thing the law recognizes as able to bear an obligation, so a market wanting a side that cannot be bound, a town before incorporation, a club, a protocol without a wrapper, a river, the unborn party to a hundred-year carbon contract, is born only when a proxy is deputized to stand for that side, and the proxy's own holds then govern the market; municipal bonds exist only because a city is a person that can be sued, and a club that is no person borrows only on its treasurer's own name, which is Cosigner and stops the day the treasurer will not sign; the trading twin of witness-architectures' Deputized injury, which names who may bring a harm, and the two come apart, since a river with a guardian can sue but nobody lends to a river, because no hold reaches the guardian's purse; escaped by dissolving the person or by immunity; bought in a day for a company, never for a river.

items.item: Keep the car: the hold arises from the shape of the trade itself when the thing worked on sits in the worker's hands, as the garage keeps the car, the tailor the suit, the innkeeper the luggage, the warehouse the grain, until the bill is paid; repair to strangers exists only because the object can be held, and the same trade on an object that cannot be held, a roof, a field, a hull at sea, fails until statute invents a registered lien on the house in the garage's place; escaped by abandoning the thing when it is worth less than the bill, so a hold on a wreck holds nothing; acquired the moment the thing is handed over, needing no deposit, no court, no name.
items.why: 'A hull at sea' is the wrong example for the fork to Seizable title: the ship repairer holds a maritime lien that needs no registry and no statute, enforced by arrest in the next port, which is this map's Hold at the crossing. The trade on an unholdable object forks three ways, not two, and the item should send the ship to the crossing.
items.repair: Keep the car: the hold arises from the shape of the trade itself when the thing worked on sits in the worker's hands, as the garage keeps the car, the tailor the suit, the innkeeper the luggage, the warehouse the grain, until the bill is paid; repair to strangers exists only because the object can be held, and the same trade on an object that cannot be held, a roof, a field, a standing crop, fails until statute invents a registered lien on the house in the garage's place, while the ship repaired and gone to sea is held by no registry but by arrest in the next port, which is the crossing's hold; escaped by abandoning the thing when it is worth less than the bill, so a hold on a wreck holds nothing; acquired the moment the thing is handed over, needing no deposit, no court, no name.

items.item: Place in line: a party is bound by an ordering it cannot transfer and would lose by leaving, as the pilot's seniority number, the union hall's out-of-work book, the pension that vests at ten years, the founder's equity that vests over four; the airline's investment in a pilot's training exists only because the pilot cannot take the number to another carrier, and the same airline binds the newcomer, whose number is worth nothing yet, by a training bond, a deposit, until the list takes over; escaped only by the institution's own death, since a bankruptcy wipes the list, so the hold is only as good as the institution's name; adjacent to exchange-ontologies' Priority, which names the good, and survival-floors' Hiring hall, which names the floor, this names the hold the institution gets in return; accrued only by staying, and the purest such hold, since the wait itself is the deposit.
items.why: The pension that vests at ten years and the equity that vests over four are Held-back pay, the counterparty's own money released by a time condition, exactly as retainage is released by completion; keeping them here is the one place two items fail to separate. The distinct hold is the rank among peers that nobody owes and every other list starts at the bottom; the exchange book's time priority, lost by cancelling and re-entering, is a remote-domain case that shows it.
items.repair: Place in line: a party is bound by an ordering it cannot transfer and would lose by leaving, as the pilot's seniority number, the union hall's out-of-work book, the tenure line, the resting order's time priority in an exchange's book, lost by cancelling and re-entering; the airline's investment in a pilot's training exists only because the pilot cannot take the number to another carrier, and the same airline binds the newcomer, whose number is worth nothing yet, by a training bond, a deposit, until the list takes over; not held-back pay, which is what the pension that vests at ten years and the equity that vests over four really are, since those are the counterparty's own money released by time, but a rank among peers that nobody owes and that every other list starts at the bottom; escaped only by the institution's own death, since a bankruptcy wipes the list, so the hold is only as good as the institution's name; adjacent to exchange-ontologies' Priority, which names the good, and survival-floors' Hiring hall, which names the floor, this names the hold the institution gets in return; accrued only by staying, and the purest such hold, since the wait itself is the deposit.

items.item: Tap: a party becomes bindable the moment it depends on a flow the other side can cut, as the postpaid electricity account, the cloud tenancy, the payment processor, the app store, each of which binds its customer by disconnection rather than by any court; postpaid utility service to strangers exists only because the tap can be shut, and where winter moratoria forbid the cutoff the utility demands a deposit instead; escaped by multi-homing or by becoming too important to cut, as a hospital is; not a license, which a third party revokes to protect others, but a supply the creditor itself withholds, and the one hold a stranger acquires within the hour, by needing.
items.why: My boundary case (asset specificity, the supplier who tooled a line for one customer) belongs here, but only if a flow of custom counts as a tap; the item says 'a supply the creditor itself withholds', which reads one-directional and leaves the hold-up as an apparent gap. One clause closes it.
items.repair: Tap: a party becomes bindable the moment it depends on a flow the other side can cut, as the postpaid electricity account, the cloud tenancy, the payment processor, the app store, each of which binds its customer by disconnection rather than by any court; postpaid utility service to strangers exists only because the tap can be shut, and where winter moratoria forbid the cutoff the utility demands a deposit instead; escaped by multi-homing or by becoming too important to cut, as a hospital is; not a license, which a third party revokes to protect others, but a flow the creditor itself withholds, in either direction, the supply a seller can cut or the custom a buyer can withdraw, so the supplier who tooled a line for one customer is bound by that customer's orders; the one hold a stranger acquires within the hour, by needing.

items.item: Seizable title: a party is bindable through property only if a registry ties the property to its name so that a creditor can find it and take it, as the land registry, the vehicle title, the filed lien; the mortgage exists only because of the registry, and lending against unregistered land fails everywhere the deed cannot be searched, so the same house is collateral in one country and dead weight in the next; escaped by moving the asset past the registry's reach or into an exempt class, the homestead, the pension, the tools; adjacent to survival-floors' Tools the bailiff cannot take, which names the exemptions as a floor, this names what the exemptions are carved from; acquired only by owning something registered, which takes a purchase and a registry, not a day.
items.why: 'Lending against unregistered land fails everywhere the deed cannot be searched' is de Soto's thesis and is contested (informal-title lending exists; formal titling programs have often failed to produce credit); the map elsewhere marks the Maghribi reading and should mark this one.
items.repair: Seizable title: a party is bindable through property only if a registry ties the property to its name so that a creditor can find it and take it, as the land registry, the vehicle title, the filed lien; the mortgage exists only because of the registry, and, on de Soto's contested reading, lending against unregistered land fails wherever the deed cannot be searched, so the same house is collateral in one country and dead weight in the next; escaped by moving the asset past the registry's reach or into an exempt class, the homestead, the pension, the tools; adjacent to survival-floors' Tools the bailiff cannot take, which names the exemptions as a floor, this names what the exemptions are carved from; acquired only by owning something registered, which takes a purchase and a registry, not a day.

items.item: Name worth keeping: a judgment attaches to a name, so a party is bindable through its name only when the name is worth more to it than any single default, as a firm with a brand, a family with a name in the village, a person whose identity is the one thing it cannot replace; the warranty, the prepaid subscription, the long-dated contract exist only because the name will be there to answer, and the gift card from a pop-up fails with the pop-up; escaped by the phoenix, the company dissolved and re-formed under a new name with the old debts left on the corpse, and by the synthetic identity, which is the phoenix for persons; not reputation, which is what a name carries, but the persistence to which anything can attach at all; accrued by staying under one name, which is why a stranger's name binds nothing.
items.why: Tested as my closest-neighbor pair against Rent as leash; separates (see neighbor_test). The mechanism clause (worth more than any default) and the discriminator (persistence, not reputation) pull against each other, but the phoenix escape shows the author means both: the name is the attachment point and its worth is what stops the party shedding it.

items.item: Rent as leash: a party is bound by a revocable permission exactly in proportion to what the permission is worth, so a license binds only through its scarcity, as a medical license is worth more than any single bribe and a taxi medallion at a million dollars bound its owner while the same medallion at a tenth of that bound nobody; surgery by a stranger exists only because the license can be pulled, and the unlicensed trades, the handyman, the mover, run on deposits and small worlds instead; escaped by being the marginal licensee to whom the license is worth little, or by practicing without one; adjacent to cooperation-mechanisms' sunsetting of privileges, which names the sanction, this names the leash's length as the rent, so that a licensor makes its licensees bindable by restricting entry; earned over years, and held by the licensor.
items.why: Separates from Name (see neighbor_test) and from Tap (a licensor revokes to protect third parties; a tap is cut by the creditor for itself). Modality note below on the medallion claim. Its seriation slot is questionable (see seriation) but that is the walk's problem, not the item's.

neighbor_test.left: Name worth keeping: a judgment attaches to a name, so a party is bindable through its name only when the name is worth more to it than any single default, as a firm with a brand, a family with a name in the village, a person whose identity is the one thing it cannot replace; the warranty, the prepaid subscription, the long-dated contract exist only because the name will be there to answer, and the gift card from a pop-up fails with the pop-up; escaped by the phoenix, the company dissolved and re-formed under a new name with the old debts left on the corpse, and by the synthetic identity, which is the phoenix for persons; not reputation, which is what a name carries, but the persistence to which anything can attach at all; accrued by staying under one name, which is why a stranger's name binds nothing.
neighbor_test.right: Rent as leash: a party is bound by a revocable permission exactly in proportion to what the permission is worth, so a license binds only through its scarcity, as a medical license is worth more than any single bribe and a taxi medallion at a million dollars bound its owner while the same medallion at a tenth of that bound nobody; surgery by a stranger exists only because the license can be pulled, and the unlicensed trades, the handyman, the mover, run on deposits and small worlds instead; escaped by being the marginal licensee to whom the license is worth little, or by practicing without one; adjacent to cooperation-mechanisms' sunsetting of privileges, which names the sanction, this names the leash's length as the rent, so that a licensor makes its licensees bindable by restricting entry; earned over years, and held by the licensor.
neighbor_test.separating_case: Both bind a party in proportion to the value of something it holds that can be destroyed, so they are the closest pair. A new dentist with a fresh license and no patients, and a famous unlicensed restaurant. The dentist is bound by the leash: one board can pull the license in one act, the name is worth nothing yet, and a phoenix (new name) does not help because the board's file follows the person. The restaurant is bound by the name: the health permit is cheap and reissued to any new applicant, so revoking it binds nobody, while the name is destroyed only by many customers updating independently and cannot be pulled by any one hand. The holds separate on who holds the button, one licensor or nobody, and therefore on what they bind to: the leash binds to the licensor's rules alone and can be bought off by bribing the licensor, the name binds to whatever the public happens to care about and cannot be bribed. The escapes also differ: the leash is escaped by being the marginal licensee, the name by the phoenix.

boundary_case: Specific asset: a supplier who has tooled a line for one customer, or a firm that built its plant next to one mine, is bound to that counterparty because leaving strands the investment (Williamson's asset specificity, the classic hold-up). Tempting as its own item, since whole industries of relationship-specific investment run on it and cooperation-ignitions' First cut names its ignition. Ruling: it is in, but under Tap, read from the seller's side. What the counterparty holds is a flow it can cut, custom rather than supply, and the escape is the same, multi-homing (a second customer) or becoming too important to drop. The ruling is productive because Tap as written names only the supply direction; the repair above makes the flow bidirectional so the hold-up is not an apparent gap. A true nonmember I also tried, love (the parent lends to the child because it wants the child well), is out on the author's own rule: the hold is in the party's own valuation and no stranger can see it; it enters only as the kin guarantor's hold inside Cosigner.

seriation.note: Real endpoints: Body that can be brought (nothing done) and Place in line (nothing but time). The consequential adjacency Cosigner → Portable file teaches (someone else's stay exported versus one's own, the registry as the difference between needing a mother and needing a file). Two faults, neither breaking the walk. First, the middle segment (Someone to sue, Seizable title, Hold at the crossing) is sorted by the second axis, institution needed, not by the declared axis, time-to-acquire; a company is bought in a day, which by the declared axis would put Someone to sue beside Rented door. Second, the seriation note and the dependency edge put Body that can be brought among the holds needing no institution outside the two parties, when custody needs a state, a sheriff, and a jail; Kneecap is the court-free hold at the opening, as Kneecap's own discriminator says, so the 'court-free at both ends' claim should name Kneecap, not Body. Rent as leash sits at the accrued end on the strength of 'earned over years', but the rent binds from the day the license is issued and a license moves by endorsement, which is import; the placement is authored and should be admitted as such.

edges.why: The loop's return leg as written says know-your-customer anchors a file to a body; it anchors a file to identity papers. The return to the body is real but runs through the fraud statute, which reaches the body of whoever faked the papers; without saying so, the loop closes at Rented door or Name, not at Body, and 'no hold escapes the loop except by staying' fails.
edges.repair_label: If the file can be forged, as the synthetic identity forges it, the registry trusts a file only after anchoring its name to papers the state will prosecute a body for faking, so know-your-customer is the fraud statute reaching through the document to the body; the walk that left the body through bail returns to it through the criminal court, and no hold on this map escapes the loop except by staying.

edges.why: The partition is wrong in three places: Body is the most court-dependent hold on the map and a non-person has no body of its own; Name and Rent as leash do not run through a court (a brand is destroyed by customers, a license by a licensor, and a protocol with no wrapper is bound by its name); the crossing, cosigner, and file are omitted. The dependency is real as a claim about judgments against the party itself, and the relabel keeps it a dependency that splits the map.
edges.repair_label: If the party is not a legal person, no judgment can enter against it, so the holds that need a judgment against the party itself, title, door, and the crossing, fall away, and what remains is what needs none: the tap, the deposit, the hostage, possession, held-back pay, the name, the small world, the place in line, and, on its members rather than itself, custody, harm, and the cosigner's name; a protocol with no wrapper can be cut off and disgraced but never seized, which is why every counterparty can bind it and nobody will lend to it.

edges.why: Antecedent (the party can post cash) fails for the poor, and the edge says what then happens; bail is the conversion. A sequence could not show that the exit from the first hold requires already having the fourth.
A genuine fork on whether the object fits in a garage; with the item repair the hull goes to the crossing, so the fork has a third tine, which the label need not carry.

A real incompatibility: liquid-to-the-holder and untempting cannot both hold, so escrow (a custodian) and the ugly hostage are alternatives. I tried a counterexample, cash in escrow, and it confirms the label rather than breaking it, since escrow is the custodian the label names.

modality_problems: Rented door: the escape by lapse is stated as fact and is inverted; lapse triggers substituted service and default, not escape (repaired).
Someone to sue: 'a club whose treasurer is personally liable cannot borrow at all' is false as stated; clubs borrow on the treasurer's name (repaired).
Keep the car: 'a hull at sea' fails 'until statute invents a registered lien' is wrong; the maritime lien needs no registry and is enforced by arrest in port (repaired).
Seizable title: the de Soto thesis on unregistered land is asserted as fact; contested (repaired with a marker).

Rent as leash: 'the same medallion at a tenth of that bound nobody' is an inference from the mechanism presented as an observation; no documented change in medallion holders' compliance is named. Acceptable in the analytical register if read as the mechanism's prediction; the author should not cite it as history.

Tap: 'where winter moratoria forbid the cutoff the utility demands a deposit instead' asserts a causal link between moratoria and deposit rules that is plausible and undocumented; utilities demand deposits on credit grounds regardless.

Hold at the crossing: 'sovereign lending fails wherever the sovereign keeps everything at home' overstates; sovereign lending runs mostly on Name and on the tap of future market access, both on this map, and the crossing is the marginal enforcement, not the market's precondition. Leave as authored simplification but it is the one 'fails without it' claim on the map that the map's own other items contradict.
Portable file: the passport as 'a state's vouching' is an identity anchor (Rented door or Name), not a record of a stay; a weak illustrative case, not a false one.
duplication: No item or the map as a whole duplicates a grown list. Partial overlap of illustrative case only: Portable file's nurse-and-licensing-board case is survival-floors' Passport trade seen from the hirer's side (there the registry entry is a floor, here it is a hold), and Place in line's hiring hall and exchange-ontologies' Priority are correctly named as adjacent. cooperation-mechanisms' bare phrases (hostages, slashable collateral, exclusion, legible reputation) are not restated; the boundary_claim's own defense of this is accurate. Cosigner adjoins exchange-ontologies' Vouching and says what it adds.
best_unresolved_seed: The ledger's own residue, the file that will not travel: a platform seller's reviews, an account's accumulated history, a gig worker's rating, which bind by refusing to be carried out. It is Portable file's content behaving as Place in line's hold, a record whose non-portability is the platform's leash on everyone who has stayed, and it is the hold under which most people now work; the map's second axis (whether the hold needs an institution outside the two parties) and its 'exported stay' lesson would both have to be re-derived once a stay can be recorded by one party and refused export by design.
independent_review_line: Fable critic: admitted after relabeling the dependency and loop edges, whose partitions misfiled custody, name, and license, repairing Rented door's inverted escape and three false illustrative claims, moving vesting out of Place in line into Held-back pay, and cutting nothing.
